test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

OILS: UNLS:: PAIN: PKDT:: QUIK:?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First letter → (4) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Second letter → (3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Third and fourth letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

​​So,

 
• ​OILS: UNLS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57adcaf26ed59e5bb663b16a8915966404e9bed31183275237f2707f60d3c553.png] 

​And,

 
• PAIN : PKDT

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb07e8774c068c8371060d7b52b70d1d06a365c2af7d5fd3b941028cbd554627.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• QUIK: ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96e7401c13a0d427b18b401838ad0102d84ac91c7a3bbaa0f961e20873370159.png] 

Hence, "**MKXU**" is the correct answer.
